title: Types (Part 1) - Tuples and arrays
learning_objectives: Read tuple and array types in a function signature.
Destructure a tuple into named values.
Convert array elements to a wider numeric type before summing them.
explanation: This slice focuses on compound data types rather than Rust's full type system. The lesson uses a tuple and a fixed-size array together so the learner can practice destructuring, indexing, and explicit numeric conversion in one contained exercise.

examples.title: Read scalar annotations around compound values
Destructure the tuple into named fields
Sum values from a fixed-size array

compiler_error_examples: error[E0277]: the trait bound `i32: From<u32>` is not satisfied
completion_criteria: Exercise tests pass for ordinary and zero-valued inputs
Learner can identify which values come from the tuple and which come from the array
Learner can explain why the sum is accumulated as `i32` instead of `i16`
